Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We reviewed the proposed renewal and want to proceed, but we need the renewal paperwork to reflect a capacity reallocation between two internal business units: Platform (70%) and AI Lab (30%). The key asks from our side:

- Exhibit C needs a line-item that shows the split and the new monthly committed tokens.
- We want pro-rated billing for the partial month when the swap becomes effective (target date 2027-01-01).
- No change to the core MSA (term and data protections stay the same), but we'd like an addendum rather than a full orderform rewrite.

Can you share the redline draft for Exhibit C and the proposed addendum flow (DocuSign vs. email countersign)? Our procurement/legal team is copied.

Attachments: internal spreadsheet they referenced (not included).

Appreciate the help — Gabe

Thanks for the background and the draft. I reviewed redlines_acadia_20261028.docx and the one-page addendum. High level: the approach is fine, but I have a few edits to reduce ambiguity and speed countersign.

Key edits I suggest (summarized):
- Replace "pro-rated billing" language with: "For the billing period in which the effective date occurs, Redwood will calculate fees on a pro rata basis using the actual number of days in the billing cycle attributable to each allocation. Fees will be rounded to the nearest whole dollar. No retroactive credits except as required under the SLA."
- Clarify Exhibit C table: add columns for "Business Unit Owner" and "Committed Tokens (monthly)" and lock the total committed tokens to the current contract total so we don't unintentionally increase exposure.
- Add a short clause that states: "This addendum does not alter Redwood's service levels or data handling obligations under the MSA; any changes to SLA or coverage must be separately documented and signed."
- Add signature block for procurement and an automated DocuSign routing clause: "Execution may occur via DocuSign; electronic signature is binding." This will make routing to Acadia procurement smoother.

I've attached my redline. If we get verbal confirmation from Gabe on the proposed wording (particularly the rounding and no-retroactive-credit sentence), I approve moving forward with DocuSign. Ben — please insert the final committed token numbers in the Exhibit C table and update the HubSpot deal (link below).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890

I'll be on PTO next Monday but can review the final envelope if needed.

- Lauren
